Subject: MAP preflight & roll-call — finalize evaluation trackers and owners

Hi Judy (& Luis),

Following our discovery last week, I'd like to run a short MAP preflight before we kick off the formal evaluation. Goal: make the weekly checkpoints predictable, confirm evaluation owners, and lock the cadence so we can hit your June close window.

Proposed items for the call (30 minutes):
- Quick status: what you have running today (data flow + sample workloads)
- Eval scope & success criteria (latency, throughput, quality thresholds)
- Tracker ownership for each eval bucket (functional tests, perf, security, compliance)
- Calendar cadence & who needs to be invited for weekly readouts

Prework (attached):
- Atlas_MAP_v2.xlsx — our suggested MAP with proposed owners (please review and mark changes)
- Eval_checklist.pdf — short checklist to confirm test harness and data access

Availability: can we lock a 30-min slot next week? Suggested windows (your TZ):
- Tue May 4: 09:00–11:00 ET
- Wed May 5: 14:00–16:00 ET

If those don't work, give 2 windows and we'll triangulate. I'll own the meeting notes and action tracker.

Thanks,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
